LESSON: INDIGENOUS KENYAN INSTRUMENTAL ENSEMBLES

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Performing and Displaying
Topic 2.3: Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How can one play an instrument as part of an instrumental ensemble?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the categories of indigenous Kenyan instrumental ensembles
2. describe factors to consider when playing in an instrumental ensemble

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the categories of indigenous Kenyan instrumental ensembles
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the categories of indigenous Kenyan instrumental ensembles. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. describe factors to consider when playing in an instrumental ensemble
   In simple words: practise until you can describe factors to consider when playing in an instrumental ensemble. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles in the examples.
2. Explain Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
4. Show that you can: identify the categories of indigenous Kenyan instrumental ensembles

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Tune the selected instrument using appropriate technique,
2. Citizenship: The learner interacts with and plays indigenous Kenyan musical instruments in an ensemble.
3. Communication and collaboration: The learner teams up with peers to perform as an ensemble. Values:
4. Peace: The learner interacts with musical instruments from diverse Kenyan communities enhancing appreciation of different cultures hence peaceful coexistence.
5. Unity: The learner plays a musical instrument with peers in an ensemble.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the categories of indigenous Kenyan instrumental ensembles
2. describe factors to consider when playing in an instrumental ensemble

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
